verified_partial: Mean intervals now use mean +/- 1.96 standard errors; report values independently matched under the iid normal approximation, not a sampling-design guarantee.
Added island-adjusted mass and nitrogen isotope OLS coefficients and R-squared independently matched (n=324).
Added species/island cross-tabulation and overlapping isotope missingness counts.
remaining_errors: Group-specific averages of fitted values remain mislabeled adjusted means; they equal observed group means, not common-reference standardization.
Report section 11 has 13 both-missing plus 1 nitrogen-only, while limitations still claims 27 isotope-missing individuals; actual union is 14.
Counts all 190 ID groups as multi-year and asserts repeated animals; only 114 IDs appear in multiple years, 76 occur once, and global ID collisions do not establish animal identity.
Claims species and island effects cannot separately be identified; additive model design is rank 9/9. Limited support and extrapolation remain important, but differ from rank nonidentifiability.
Confidence interval DataFrame has swapped Species column labels for Chinstrap/Gentoo despite correct numerical row index and report.
Original quantile-based error bars remain unchanged in plot, despite corrected textual mean intervals.
No substantive sampling sensitivity, carbon-isotope adjusted model or verified cross-table linkage; numerical results mostly printed rather than saved as auditable tables.
Report overstates missingness bias evidence and contains unsupported isotope-direction interpretations.

scientific_scope: Single development-task feedback adaptation; neither independent transfer nor parameter benefit.
